newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris Jan-May postal traffic up 4pct - ADP.
newsitem.headline: Paris Jan-May postal traffic up 4pct - ADP.

text.p: The Paris airports, Charles de Gaulle (CDG) and Orly, handled 55,739 tonnes of postal traffic in the first five months of 1997, an increase of four percent on the same period last year, Paris airport authority (ADP) figures show.
In May postal traffic at 10,371 tonnes was up 13 percent rise on May 1996.
The number of flights wholly dedicated to postal traffic in Jan-May was 3,478, an increase of 11.4 percent on last year.
Post only flights carried 62.5 percent of global postal tonnage in Jan-May compared to 56.9 percent on the same 1996 period.
